profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at Synapse Product Development

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Software engineer for consumer electronics product development

positions.title: Product Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Overhauled post production verification tests on managed NAND devices to optimize test efficiency, improve testing methods, and clarify resultant output data
- Organized and ran temperature tests to validate device operation on operating temperature bounds
- Developed temperature analysis tool to sample operating data from managed NAND devices

positions.title: Network System Engineering Intern
positions.description: Wrote and managed ground tests on the network capabilities of the 737. Designed faster method of loading software onto electrical units that eliminate outdated techniques and components. Developed a web tool that displays the status, value, and label of electrical ports associated with the 737’s onboard network.

positions.title: Student Coordinator
positions.description: I help direct over eighty student employees who make our unit function. Some of my responsibilities are training, keeping track of attendance, leading by example, opening and closing a unit and being the liaison between the management team and the student employees.

positions.title: Design Engineering Intern
positions.description: Design, analysis, test, certification of Mechanical and Hydraulic Systems, including landing gear actuation, steering, brake control, door mechanisms, hydraulic power generation and standard parts. Received exposure to manufacturing and factory operations. Revised functional tests for parts, reviewed trends in part failures, and analyzed CATIA models to maximize production efficiency.

positions.title: Cashier
positions.description: I operated computerized cash register system. I am knowledgeable of all food codes and classifications. I demonstrated effective communication skills with all age groups when providing customer service.

positions.title: Private Tutor
positions.description: I tutored high school Statistics, Geography, History, Algebra and Trigonometry. I consistently tutored 4 students over the course of 2 academic years

educations.fieldOfStudy: Electrical Engineering with an Embedded Systems Concentration
